module fsm #(
    parameter s0 = 3'b000,
    parameter s1 = 3'b001,
    parameter s2 = 3'b010,
    parameter s3 = 3'b011,
    parameter s4 = 3'b100,
    parameter s5 = 3'b101
) (
    input IN,
    output reg MATCH,
    input CLK,
    input RST
);


reg [2:0] ST_cr, ST_ns;

always @(*) begin
    case(ST_cr)
        s0: begin
            if(IN == 1) ST_ns = s1; else ST_ns = s0;
        end
        s1: begin
            if(IN == 1) ST_ns = s1; else ST_ns = s2;
        end
        s2: begin
            if(IN == 1) ST_ns = s1; else ST_ns = s3;
        end
        s3: begin
            if(IN == 1) ST_ns = s4; else ST_ns = s0;
        end
        s4: begin
            if(IN == 1) ST_ns = s5; else ST_ns = s2;
        end
        s5: begin
            if(IN == 1) ST_ns = s1; else ST_ns = s2;
        end
        default: ST_ns = s0;
    endcase
end

always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
    if(RST) begin
        ST_cr <= s0;
    end else begin
        ST_cr <= ST_ns;
    end
end

always @(*) begin
    if(RST) begin
        MATCH = 1'b0;
    end else if(ST_cr == s4 && IN == 1) begin
        MATCH = 1'b1;
    end else begin
        MATCH = 1'b0;
    end
end
endmodule

<module id="fsm">
    <description>Detection Circuit Mealy FSM</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">IN input.</input>
        <input id="CLK">CLK input.</input>
        <input id="RST">RST input.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">MATCH output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
    reg [3:0]count;
    
    initial begin
      count = 0;
      end
    
    always @(posedge CLK, posedge RST )begin
       if(RST == 1'b1)
            count <= 0;
         else begin
             if(IN==1 && count==0)
                count <= 1;
             else if(IN==0 && count==1)
                count <= 2;
             else if(IN==0 && count==2)
                count <= 3;
             else if(IN==1 && count==3)
                count <= 4;
             else if(IN==1 && count==4)
                count <= 5;
             else if(IN==0 && count>=5 && count<=9)
                count <= count + 2;
             else if(IN==1 && count==5)
                count <= 6;
             else if(IN==1 && count==6)
                count <= 7;
             else if(IN==0 && count==7)
                count <= 8;
             else if(IN==1 && count==8)
                count <= 9;
             else if(IN==1 && count==9)
                count <= 0;
             else
                 count <= 0;
           end
     end
